headline: ‘American Psycho’ Was Duncan Sheik’s Darkest Work. Was It Also His Best?
context: In translating synth pop to a theatrical format in the “American Psycho” musical, Sheik matched what he did with rock in the acclaimed “Spring Awakening.”
